parameters.name: FOREIGN
parameters.help: Selecting 'Yes' will change the behavior of the menus that are used to select datasets.

parameters.name: LABEL
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a dataset from the datasets menu.

parameters.name: LABEL_AL
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a dataset from another line/survey.

parameters.name: SORTOPT
parameters.help: Input traces can be sorted using header entries, or ALL traces in the dataset can be sequentially read in.

choices.label: Get All
choices.help: Read in all traces in the dataset sequentially. (In their current sort order.)

choices.label: Sort
choices.help: Input traces will be sorted to the requested order, based on one or more header entries.

parameters.name: IDA_OPT
parameters.help: Interactive Data Access may be used for certain processing modules to select new input traces on the fly.

parameters.name: PKEYNAM
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the HEADERS menu to use as the primary key for specifying 'Sort' traces.

parameters.name: SKEYNAM
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu to use as the secondary key for specifying 'Sort' traces.

parameters.name: TKEYNAM
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header entry from the headers menu to use as the tertiary key for specifying 'Sort' traces.

parameters.name: KEYLIST
parameters.help: Use MB1 to access the editor and define the input trace list. Use an asterisk (*) to default any header's values ( Ex: FFID,CHAN; *:*/ )

parameters.name: MEM_SORT
parameters.prompt: Presort in memory or on disk?
parameters.help: The input presort list can be created in memory or on disk, depending on resource requirements.

choices.label: Memory
choices.help: Presort traces in memory (faster, but may exhaust memory resources).

choices.label: Disk
choices.help: Presort traces on disk (slower, but capable of very large sorts)

parameters.name: iterate
parameters.help: Do you wish to read the data multiple times, from beginning to end?

parameters.name: DISKITER
parameters.help: Enter the number of times that you wish to read the data.

parameters.name: THDRONLY
parameters.help: Do you wish to process trace headers only (for header math, loading geometry info, etc.)?

parameters.name: sr_option
parameters.help: Set to 'Yes' if your input data's sample interval is NOT correct on disk and you need to OVERRIDE it to continue!

parameters.name: SAMPRATE
parameters.help: Enter the correct sample interval (in milliseconds) of your input data.
